description: This file defines an enum called Sensor, representing different sensor types and their properties in a vehicle control or diagnostics system. It includes sensor categories, units, value ranges, color coding for UI, and methods for lookup and processing sensor values.

classes.name: Sensor
classes.description: An enum representing various sensors with associated metadata like category, units, value ranges, and color coding, with helper methods for lookup and value translation.

methods.name: getSensorsForCategory
methods.description: Returns a collection of sensors belonging to a specified category, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Looks up a Sensor enum value by its name, returns a default if not found.

methods.name: processAdvance
methods.description: Processes advance values to keep them within a certain range, adjusting values over 360 degrees.

methods.name: translateValue
methods.description: Transforms the sensor reading, especially for advance-related sensors, to a normalized value.
